item.many_bows.aurora_bow.tooltip.extend.en: This bow requires both arrows and Rift Shards to fire.
item.many_bows.aurora_bow.tooltip.extend.zh: 这把弓需要箭矢和裂缝碎片才能发射。
item.many_bows.aurora_bow.tooltip.extend.vi: Cây cung này cần có mũi tên và các mảnh nứt để bắn.

item.many_bows.aurora_bow.item_use.en: You need Rift Shards to use this bow!
item.many_bows.aurora_bow.item_use.zh: 你需要裂缝碎片来使用这把弓！
item.many_bows.aurora_bow.item_use.vi: You need Rift Shards to use this bow!

advancement.too_many_bows.repair.descrip.en: Use this crystal to repair your bows on an anvil...
advancement.too_many_bows.repair.descrip.zh: 使用这块水晶在铁砧上修复你的弓……
advancement.too_many_bows.repair.descrip.vi: Sử dụng viên pha lê này trên đe để sửa cây cung của bạn...

item.many_bows.repair_crystal.tooltip.vi: Một tinh thể năng lượng thuần khiết.

item.many_bows.repair_crystal.tooltip.us.en: Use in an anvil to repair bows.
item.many_bows.repair_crystal.tooltip.us.zh: 在铁砧上使用以修复弓。
item.many_bows.repair_crystal.tooltip.us.vi: Sử dụng trên đe để sửa cung.

item.many_bows.rift_shard.tooltip.vi: Một mảnh năng lượng thuần khiết.

item.many_bows.rift_shard.tooltip.use.en: Use to infuse the Aurora's Grace bow arrows powerful enough to be fired.
item.many_bows.rift_shard.tooltip.use.zh: 用于为极光之恩弓的箭矢注入足够强大的能量以进行发射。
item.many_bows.rift_shard.tooltip.use.vi: Được sử dụng để bơm đủ năng lượng vào các mũi tên của Aurora's Grace Bow để bắn ra.

item.many_bows.cursed_stone.tooltip.info.en: Used to craft the Necro Bow

item.many_bows.verdant_vigor.tooltip.en: A bow imbued with the essence of nature.

item.many_bows.verdant_vigor.tooltip.abi.en: Holding this bow grants health and heals nearby allies.
item.many_bows.verdant_vigor.tooltip.abi.zh: 持有此弓可获得生命值并治疗附近的盟友。

item.many_bows.verdant_vigor.tooltip.leg.en: Legends speak of its power to breathe life into barren lands.
item.many_bows.verdant_vigor.tooltip.leg.zh: 传说中，它能为贫瘠的土地注入生机。

item.many_bows.twin_shadows.tooltip.en: A bow imbued with the essence of light and shadow.

item.many_bows.twin_shadows.tooltip.abil.en: Fires twin arrows: one of light and one of darkness.
item.many_bows.twin_shadows.tooltip.abil.zh: 发射双箭：一箭光明，一箭黑暗。

item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.en: A bow blessed by celestial light.

item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.ability.en: Radiant energy damages undead, heals allies, and blinds foes.
item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.ability.zh: 光辉能量可以伤害亡灵、治疗盟友并使敌人失明。

item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.info.en: Consumes experience points to fire radiant arrows.
item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.info.zh: 消耗经验值发射光辉箭。

item.many_bows.radiance.tooltip.xp.zh: 经验消耗：§c%d XP§r 每击。

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.mark.en: Marked enemies take increased damage and leave a damaging trail.
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.mark.zh: 被标记的敌人受到的伤害会增加，并留下伤害轨迹。

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.spect.en: Fully charged shots create a spectral zone that damages and slows enemies.
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.spect.zh: 完全蓄力射击会产生一个幽灵区域，对敌人造成伤害并使其减速。

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.effec.en: Marked enemies explode on death, dealing AoE damage.
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.effec.zh: 被标记的敌人死亡时会爆炸，造成范围伤害。

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.debuf.en: Applies Weakness, Slowness, and constant damage to marked targets.
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.debuf.zh: 对标记目标施加虚弱、缓慢和持续伤害。

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.glow.en: Marked enemies are visible through walls.
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.tooltip.glow.zh: 被标记的敌人可以透过墙壁看到。

item.many_bows.soulfragment.tooltip.info.en: Used to fire the Dusk Reaper bow

item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.tooltip.i.en: A mystical bow that fires radiant arrows fueled by your hunger.
item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.tooltip.i.zh: 一张神秘的弓，能以你的饥饿为动力射出光辉箭。

item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.tooltip.h.zh: 消耗 %s 点饥饿值每击。

item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.tooltip.l.en: Harnesses your energy to unleash powerful attacks.
item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.tooltip.l.zh: 利用你的能量发动强大的攻击。

item.many_bows.ethereal_hunter.no_hunger.en: You are too hungry to fire the bow!

item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.no_soul_fragm.en: You need Soul Fragments to fire this bow!
item.many_bows.dusk_reaper.no_soul_fragm.zh: 你需要灵魂残片来发射这把弓！

item.many_bows.aurora_bow.no_rift_shard.en: You need a Rift shard to fire this bow!
item.many_bows.aurora_bow.no_rift_shard.zh: 你需要裂隙碎片来发射这把弓！

item.many_bows.radiance.no_experience.en: This bow requires XP to fire!
item.many_bows.radiance.no_experience.zh: 需要经验来发射这把弓！

item.too_many_bows.webstring_volley.tool.en: Unleash a volley of arrows in a wide spread.

item.too_many_bows.webstring_volley.deta.en: Shoots 5 arrows in a spread pattern, applying slowness to targets.
item.too_many_bows.webstring_volley.deta.zh: 以散射模式射出 5 支箭，对目标施加缓慢。

item.too_many_bows.torchbearer_bow.toolt.en: Holding the bow gives off light.

item.too_many_bows.torchbearer_bow.shift.en: Ignites enemies and lights your path.

item.too_many_bows.torchbearer_bow.effec.en: Shoots fire arrows that place torches upon impact.
